items.title: Add observation aggregation for candidate generation consumption and recommendation handling
items.context: Compute read-only counts from real .lattice/learning playbooks, outcome ledger, decision log, and non-deducible registry. Treat hold as non-actionable and classify recommend_activate/reject/archive/recommend_demote/mark_non_deducible as handled or unhandled from current store state.
items.userSees: JSON/text output includes "candidateGenerated.currentCandidates", "candidateConsumed.consumedCandidateCount", and "candidateConsumed.unconsumedCurrentCandidateIds" based only on explicit learning rows.

happy.desc: Synthetic store reports current candidate count and consumed candidate ids from explicit candidate-inspection outcome rows.

edge.desc: Empty or missing learning ledgers report zero counts plus malformed row diagnostics without creating files.

adversarial.desc: DONE success or candidate existence alone is never counted as helped/consumed; exposureMode=none is excluded from consumed candidate counts.

items.title: Expose host-neutral playbook_promotion_observe command
items.context: Register a read-only command with --since and --json. It must support relative windows such as 14d, write nothing, and report authority=non_authoritative plus gateEvidence=false.
items.userSees: User runs lattice playbook_promotion_observe --since=14d --json and sees JSON proof without mutations.

happy.desc: lattice playbook_promotion_observe --since=14d --json emits host-neutral JSON with candidateGenerated, candidateConsumed, recommendationHandling, authority=non_authoritative, and gateEvidence=false.

edge.desc: Relative since windows such as 14d are accepted and invalid since values fail with a clear playbook_promotion_observe diagnostic.

adversarial.desc: Command policy and process-fact metadata classify playbook_promotion_observe as readOnly/L0 and not a Codex/Claude adapter namespace command.

items.title: Add focused smoke coverage and documentation note
items.context: Cover empty real-store posture and synthetic candidate/outcome/recommendation cases, including consumed/unconsumed candidate and handled/unhandled recommend_activate. Document that observation is evidence gathering, not automatic promotion.
items.userSees: Smoke output includes playbook promotion observe smoke passed and observation says to automate only when real backlog exists.

happy.desc: Focused smoke covers empty store, synthetic candidate generation, candidate consumption, unhandled recommendation, and handled recommendation after explicit activation.

edge.desc: Documentation states playbook_promotion_observe is evidence gathering for M7/M8 readiness, not automatic activation, trial traffic, timer registration, or DONE gate evidence.

adversarial.desc: Smoke proves unexposed candidate outcomes and mere candidate existence do not satisfy consumed/helped evidence.
